constraints: Requires the current raw and extracted dbgtext objects. Reconstructs the actual Ninja compiler edge and refuses unless its fresh full object is byte-identical. Every source variant is scratch-only; production pins and flags remain unchanged. --forms all means only the finite named set. PASS means requested compiles completed, not exact matching. Reports raw words, target relocation bindings, siblings, non-text and EH separately. Anonymous EH names normalize to section/offset; EMB_SDA21 normalizes only its instruction-site +2 convention. The counter witness binds the complete reviewed [+0x7c,+0x1c4) target/raw intervals; it is neither a general CFG proof nor a replacement for savedregs. Refuses changed source anchors or witness bytes.
name: r70_dbgtext_lifetimes
purpose: Reproduce the finite R70 full-TU dbgtext source-identity controls and the narrowly reviewed savedregs loop-pairing counterexample; not a raw-match or compiler-unreachability proof.
